patch_description: This constructor switches from fixed layered templates to a contact-graph multistart strategy. It starts from a dense 5×5 scaffold with an interstitial 26th circle, then uses deterministic symmetry-breaking perturbations to explore several distinct local contact graphs. All circle radii and centers are optimized simultaneously with analytic Jacobians for wall and pair-clearance constraints, substantially reducing SLSQP finite-difference overhead. A final global certification scale guarantees strict containment and non-overlap despite optimizer tolerances.
